sources.title: Instantons and Supersymmetry

evidence.text: How does instanton calculus describe nonperturbative effects in four-dimensional globally supersymmetric gauge theories with N=1,2,4, and how are gauge instantons related to D-branes and tests of gauge/string duality? This is a pedagogical review.

sources.title: Gauge and gravitational instantons: From 3-forms and fermions to Weak Gravity and flat axion potentials

evidence.text: Can fermion exchange between distinct instantons add a distance-dependent force between externally imposed θ-domain walls? The calculation uses one light Dirac flavor, two planar walls, a small source, and the first two orders in the instanton-induced interaction.

sources.title: Power Towers of String Instantons for N=1 Vacua

evidence.text: Can string instantons correct other instantons' actions, producing iterated power towers in N=1 holomorphic couplings, and can a refined D-brane instanton calculus distinguish these effects from multiply wrapped single instantons in a proposed heterotic–Type I dual pair?

sources.title: Gauging the Standard Model 1-form symmetry via gravitational instantons

evidence.text: Can Eguchi–Hanson gravitational instantons support consistent Standard Model electric Z6 1-form fluxes, provide a semiclassical realization of gauging this symmetry, and induce baryon- and lepton-number violation?

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: How can ordinary four-dimensional gauge instantons realize charged endpoint dressing? The model couples chiral U(1)-charged SU(N) fermions to a gauged axion whose topological coupling cancels their mixed gauge variation.

sources.title: A Note on Poly-Instanton Effects in Type IIB Orientifolds on Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: What sufficient E3-instanton zero-mode conditions generate poly-instanton corrections in compact Type IIB O7/O3 orientifolds, and can suitable divisors coexist with shrinkable del Pezzo surfaces relevant to LARGE volume constructions?

destinations.title: Could D-brane instantons provide the up-quark mass generation needed by the construction? The source nominates this possibility and references earlier work, but the supplied discussion begins mid-context and does not specify the relevant missing coupling or instanton.
How can heterotic worldsheet instantons correct charged superpotential couplings when the gauge bundle differs from the tangent bundle?

When can spatially separated E3 and fractional E(-1) instantons generate D3-brane Yukawa couplings, and what are their separation dependence, flavour structure and implications for superpotential desequestering?
How does D-brane instanton backreaction reproduce charged matter insertions in the four-dimensional effective action when the instanton intersects gauge D-branes?

How can heterotic world-sheet instanton superpotentials be computed for monad and extension bundles, and when can contributions in one curve class avoid cancellation despite the Beasley–Witten vanishing theorem?
Can all superpotential corrections be excluded in heterotic and other N = 1 string compactifications when stringy instanton sectors are incompletely understood?

Can gauge and worldsheet effects alone supply a universal obstruction to vanishing heterotic superpotentials? The paper tests this through standard embeddings and Bianchi-saturating non-standard candidates.

Can an explicit smooth dual geometry exhibit a stringy heterotic NS5 instanton contribution without relying on additional zero-mode lifting? The selected examples vary the discrete twist t over a P2 base.
Does the type IIB superpotential receive bare D(−1)-instanton corrections when all D7 stacks carry SO(8), and can F-theory periods determine this at finite string coupling?

How can string field theory fix the overall normalization of D-instanton contributions to the moduli superpotential in fluxless Calabi–Yau orientifolds, and do multiple instantons of the specified type contribute?
When can Euclidean D3-branes wrapping singular effective divisors generate nonperturbative superpotential terms, and how should their fermion zero modes be counted?
Which Coxeter groups arise from isomorphic flops, and how do their symmetries constrain and resum the invariant instanton functions entering the Type IIA prepotential?

How can the zeros and explicit vector-bundle-moduli dependence of a heterotic worldsheet-instanton Pfaffian, and hence its superpotential contribution, be computed? The paper develops a method and calculates one SU(3) example.

How can the vector-bundle-moduli dependence and vanishing divisor of a once-wrapped heterotic instanton's Pfaffian, and hence its superpotential contribution, be computed explicitly using algebraic geometry?

Can string duality compute flux-dependent D3-instanton superpotentials, including determinants and multiwrappings, in an explicit KKLT-type setting, and motivate a generalized GVW superpotential for type II compactifications?

How does compactifying one spatial direction of N=1 SU(N) supersymmetric Yang–Mills change its string dual, and can constituent instantons generate its nonperturbative superpotential directly in that description?

Which wrapped-brane instantons generate nonperturbative superpotentials in M-theory on Calabi–Yau fourfolds, and what can their divisor geometry establish about corresponding four-dimensional F-theory and heterotic compactifications?
